data_points.name: caller_name
data_points.prompt: The caller's own name, as they said it. Null if they did not give it.

data_points.name: caller_email
data_points.prompt: The caller's email address if they gave one, in lowercase. Null if not given.

data_points.name: locality
data_points.prompt: The area or locality of the property in Pune or Pimpri-Chinchwad, as the caller said it (for example the neighbourhood name). Null if not said.

data_points.name: project_type
data_points.prompt: What kind of property: home, office, or other (shop, restaurant, gym, anything else).

data_points.name: bhk
data_points.prompt: Number of bedrooms (the BHK) as a digit only. Null if not said.

data_points.name: carpet_area_sqft
data_points.prompt: Carpet area in square feet, as a number only. Null if not said.

data_points.name: referral_source
data_points.prompt: How the caller heard about Aangan, in a few words (friend, Instagram, Google, a hoarding, and so on). Null if not said.

data_points.name: referrer_name
data_points.prompt: The name of the person who referred them to Aangan, if they named one. Null otherwise.

data_points.name: language
data_points.prompt: The main language the CALLER spoke (not the assistant).

data_points.name: intent
data_points.prompt: new_enquiry = wants a new project designed. existing_client = is talking about a project they already have with Aangan. other = a vendor, a job seeker, a wrong number or anything else.

data_points.name: is_complaint
data_points.prompt: yes if the caller is unhappy about service on a project they already have with Aangan. no otherwise.

data_points.name: owners_attend
data_points.prompt: Whether the owners or decision-makers will attend the consultation: yes or no. Null if it was not discussed.

data_points.name: is_rental
data_points.prompt: yes if the property is rented, no if the caller owns it. Null if not said.

data_points.name: landlord_consent
data_points.prompt: For a rented property: yes if the landlord has agreed to changes, no if not. Null if not discussed.

data_points.name: asked_price
data_points.prompt: yes if the caller asked what it would cost, or asked for a rate or a price. no otherwise.

data_points.name: service_wanted
data_points.prompt: Whether the caller wants Aangan to do both the design and the execution (the actual work), only the design, or only the execution.

data_points.name: scope
data_points.prompt: What work the caller wants done, in a few words (for example full home, kitchen only, wardrobes, two bedrooms, office fit-out). Null if not said.

data_points.name: current_state
data_points.prompt: The state the property is in now, in a few words (bare, lived-in, awaiting possession, under construction). Null if not said.

data_points.name: completion_deadline
data_points.prompt: By when the caller needs the work finished, in the caller's own words (for example 'by March', 'before Diwali', 'in two months'). Never convert it into a date. Null if not said.

data_points.name: budget_volunteered
data_points.prompt: ONLY a budget the CALLER said themselves, exactly as they said it. If the caller did not say a budget, return null. NEVER a figure spoken by the assistant, and never an estimate.

data_points.name: booked_consultation
data_points.prompt: yes ONLY if the Cal.com booking tool confirmed the booking during this call and the assistant then told the caller it is booked. no in every other case, including when the caller only agreed to a callback.

data_points.name: booked_time
data_points.prompt: The day and time the assistant read back as booked, in the assistant's words. Null if no consultation was booked.

data_points.name: wants_person
data_points.prompt: yes if the caller asked to speak to a person. no otherwise.
